peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 1.5% above its local comparables; 64 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (84.7): 6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 91 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $950,000 ($1,840 psf, 505–516 sq ft; 11 resales, Apr 2024–Mar 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,823 psf (range $1,746–2,149); 0.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $9,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,300,000 ($2,000 psf, 602–753 sq ft; 9 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,993 psf (range $1,578–2,232); 0.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $5,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,106,944 ($2,176 psf, 925–979 sq ft; 6 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,111 psf (range $1,586–2,437); 3.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $63,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Serangoon MRT about 280 m, Bartley MRT about 920 m; closer than 77 of 116 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Yangzheng Primary School about 910 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 350 m), more than 99 of 116 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre about 1,380 m; nearest park Greenway South about 860 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Serangoon North MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,980 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 940 m; Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 1,230 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 152 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 738 resales (863 purchases); new sales were 14.5% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 1,810 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 738 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 110 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 738 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 814 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−9.3%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
